subject: Security exhibit negotiation — evidence windows & pen-test alignment (Lifeline Health)
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@lifelinehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lifelinehealth.com>, Dan Morgan <dan.morgan@lifelinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing for DL-4872

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to kick off the security exhibit conversation now that legal has a first pass on the MSA. We have three asks that need clear language before our GC will sign:

1) SOC 2: we need a statement of which SOC 2 scope (Type II, control set baseline) you're representing and cadence for annual attestations.
2) Pen test: our security team requires a 30d notice window and the right to request remediation evidence; we also need to confirm whether Redwood accepts a scoped staging environment for live testing.
3) Evidence cadence: we want an operational runbook (who we contact, SLAs for evidence requests, and sample set definitions).

I've attached a spreadsheet with our standard questionnaire and highlighted the MSA sections we want revised. For timeline, procurement is aiming to sign in the second half of March if we can close these items this week.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will handle the redlines and whether you can accept a limited inspection window for the pen test?

Thanks —
Amy Chen\Head of Procurement\Lifeline Health

Attachments: Lifeline_Security_Questions.xlsx (xlsx, 24 KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@lifelinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing for DL-4872

Amy —

Appreciate the clear list and the spreadsheet, very helpful. Quick answers and next steps from our side:

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report covering the security, availability, and confidentiality trust services categories. We run annual attestations; the most recent report cover period was 2026-06 to 2027-06. We can provide the report under NDA.

- Pen test: we are open to a scoped pen test in a staging environment. Our standard is a 14–30 day notice depending on the environment; for production-impacting tests we require an operations cadence. We typically request that scope and test plan be agreed 7 days prior to the window.

- Evidence cadence: we have an evidence runbook template (who/what/where) and a 3-business-day SLA for routine evidence requests and 10 business days for deeper artifact pulls. There is an escalation path to our security lead if anything falls outside that.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik will take your spreadsheet and produce a redline to the Security Exhibit (target: EOD Wed).
2) Ben will coordinate with Legal on wording for limited inspection/pen-test carveouts.
3) I can share our evidence runbook draft and propose specific sample-set definitions for confirmation.

Can you confirm procurement's latest required sign date and whether Lifeline prefers a rolling 30-day pen-test window or a fixed two-week window?

Best,
Grace\Senior Customer Success Manager\Redwood Inference

Note: adding Olga to the thread for legal intake if necessary.

From: Dan Morgan <dan.morgan@lifelinehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy.chen@lifelinehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lifelinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing for DL-4872

Grace / Team —

Thanks for the quick reply. Our GC gave us a hard target: contract must be signed by Friday, 12 Mar to align with a board review. We can be flexible on the pen-test window as long as we have explicit sample-set and staging carveouts documented.

Two clarifying asks from security:
- Can Redwood agree to provide remediation evidence (screenshots/log snippets or ticket links) within 10 business days after a high-severity finding?
- For SOC 2, please confirm whether subservice organizations are listed in the report or if they require separate attestations.

I've attached our annotated questionnaire with the redline suggestions for the Security Exhibit. If Redwood can accept the majority of those, procurement will move to legal and sign quickly.

Thanks —
Dan\Security Operations Manager, Lifeline Health

Attachments: Lifeline_Security_Questions.xlsx (annotated, xlsx, 29 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@lifelinehealth.com>, Dan Morgan <dan.morgan@lifelinehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing for DL-4872

Hi Amy / Dan —

Thanks for the annotated spreadsheet and the clear timeline. We've reviewed internally and attached our proposed redlines to the Security Exhibit (PDF). Summary of concessions and asks:

- SOC 2: we confirm Type II covering security/availability/confidentiality; subservice orgs are listed in the report addendum. We can deliver the report under NDA and will add a clause that Redwood will notify customers within 30 days if our SOC status materially changes.

- Pen test: Redwood agrees to a staged pen test on a customer-dedicated staging environment. We can accept a 30-day rolling window or a fixed two-week window — decision is yours; operationally we prefer a fixed two-week window to batch operational prep. For high-severity findings, we commit to providing initial remediation evidence (ticket id, mitigation notes, and screenshots where feasible) within 10 business days and a remediation plan within 20 business days.

- Evidence cadence / runbook: attached is our evidence runbook with named contacts (security@redwood.com, cs-evidence@redwood.com), sample-set definitions, and SLAs (3 biz days routine, 10 biz days deep pull). We propose a single point-of-contact model for evidence requests to reduce churn.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached PDF (Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v3_redlines.pdf).
2) If acceptable, procurement/GC can instruct Redwood counsel to incorporate the redlines into the MSA/order form.
3) If you prefer a rolling window, please indicate and we will mirror the exhibit language accordingly.

If possible, we'd like signoff on the exhibit language by Monday 8 Mar to hit your board deadline — we can be flexible but need a clear handshake to provision dedicated staging for the pen test.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer\Head of Trust & Safety\Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v3_redlines.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)
